_comment: Copy-paste detection over the three source trees, run by the `deadcode` gate
`threshold` is the MEASURED duplication of this repository on the day the gate
was wired (2.89% of 52,852 lines, 132 clones), not an aspiration. jscpd fails
when duplication exceeds it, and .testfortress/baseline.json records the same
number with a lower-is-better direction, so the ceiling can only ever come down.
Raising it is the exact move the ratchet exists to catch.
`minLines`/`minTokens` are jscpd's defaults. They are stated rather than
inherited because lowering the sensitivity would shrink the measured
duplication without removing a single duplicated line, which is a narrowed gate
wearing the costume of a config tweak.
Only `packages/*/src` is scanned: tests repeat themselves by nature (arrange
blocks, fixtures) and a duplication budget over them would push toward clever
shared helpers, which is the opposite of what a readable test needs.
